channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Uma segunda reunião entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a second in-person meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro in São Paulo, in addition to the acknowledged meeting by Zero Um in late November 2025. The discussions centered on securing R$134 million in financing for the film 'Dark horse', aiming to finalize negotiations. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: O fator Master nesta eleição
item.description: The Banco Master has become a relevant factor in the 2026 election, revealing the depth of the crisis involving banker Daniel Vorcaro, who sought to exploit political influence to access public funds under the false claim of private money. Senate government leader Jaques Wagner must defend himself with solid arguments, while far-right pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro cannot evade responsibility for the weak claim that the involvement was with private funds. The article stresses that it was never private money, but a scheme involving public resources and improper pressure on authorities.

item.title: E La Nave va
item.description: The DataFolha poll suggests that neither Lula has reached his electoral ceiling nor Flávio Bolsonaro maintained his floor, with a possibility of a first-round win or a technical tie in the runoff. Other candidates, especially on the right, lack momentum to gain traction in the next two months. The election appears to be shaping up as a contest between the most rejected candidates, many implicated in corruption scandals.

item.title: A dez dias do fim do prazo, governo ainda não pagou 10% do valor mínimo de emendas previstas para o 1º semestre
item.description: With ten days left until the LDO deadline, the government has not paid 10% of the minimum individual and bench amendments for the first semester, leaving R$1.6 billion in PIX amendments unpaid. As of June 18, R$15.8 billion of the R$17.3 billion allocated had been disbursed, including R$2.8 billion in PIX amendments (63% of the required amount). Experts warn the delay creates electoral imbalance in 2026, advantaging deputies with greater access to funds and entrenching a privileged 'caste' in Congress.

item.title: Novo Datafolha faz Lula manter vantagem no Rali, agregador de pesquisas do GLOBO; veja números
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll released on Saturday shows Lula maintaining his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with 45.9% versus 41.6%, according to the Rali aggregator by GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva. In the first round, Lula stands at 39.8% and Flávio at 30.9%, with other candidates collectively reaching 17%. The scenario has stabilized after an earlier rise tied to revelations about Flávio Bolsonaro’s conversations with Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Do sertanejo à MPB, Lula e Flávio buscam artistas para ampliar alcance de campanhas
item.description: Lula seeks support from MPB and left-leaning artists, with Janja acting as a cultural intermediary to broaden campaign reach. Flávio Bolsonaro, meanwhile, is targeting the sertanejo music scene to connect with rural and agribusiness voters through artists like Gusttavo Lima and strategic events. Both campaigns are leveraging cultural figures to reduce resistance and expand electoral reach, particularly among audiences not traditionally engaged with politics.

item.title: Quase três anos depois, Neymar se aproxima de retorno à seleção e coloca à prova minutos jogados pelo Santos
item.description: Neymar is nearing a return to the Brazil national team after nearly three years sidelined due to injury, having recovered from a left knee ligament and meniscus tear suffered in October 2023. He has been regaining match fitness with Santos in 2026, averaging 84.3 minutes per game across 15 appearances, and may feature against Scotland in the World Cup on Wednesday, pending his physical progress in training.

item.title: Lula atropelou Tabata e suas colegas
item.description: Lula was accused of running over Tabata Amaral and her female colleagues in a context of digital misogyny, where women face threats, persecution, sexual exposure, and silencing. The article emphasizes that such violence scales rapidly online, requiring a well-designed public response. The content is subscriber-only and calls for registration.

item.title: Trump banca o chefão no G7 e troca chumbo com Lula, que pode ficar mais isolado na América do Sul
item.description: Donald Trump arrived late to the G7 meeting and, upon entering, theatrically declared himself 'the boss', drawing attention. The incident occurred amid diplomatic tensions, with Lula potentially becoming more isolated in South America. The article is subscriber-only and highlights Trump's dominant behavior on the international stage.

item.title: Copa do Mundo: 9º dia tem Alemanha classificada e goleada da Holanda
item.description: The 9th day of the 2026 FIFA World Cup saw Germany advance to the knockout stage for the first time in 12 years, with Manuel Neuer becoming the all-time appearance leader for goalkeepers (21 matches). The Netherlands crushed Sweden 5-1, extending their World Cup winning streak to a record 14 consecutive victories. Paraguay defeated Turkey 1-0 with the fastest goal in tournament history, while Miguel Almirón became the first player sent off under the 'Vini Jr. protocol'.

item.title: Flávio, Zema e Helio Lopes defendem Neymar após fala de Lula
item.description: Right-wing politicians, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, former governor Romeu Zema, and deputy Helio Lopes, defended Neymar Jr. after President Lula called him the 'world's first home office call-up'. They criticized Lula for disparaging the player, praised Neymar’s trajectory as a symbol of overcoming adversity, and mocked First Lady Janja, suggesting she too could work remotely. The defense was made in posts on X (formerly Twitter) between June 19 and 20, 2026.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri anuncia que buscará reeleição como deputado em vez de governo de SP
item.description: Kim Kataguiri announced he will seek re-election as a federal deputy in 2026, ruling out a candidacy for governor of São Paulo. He stated his mission is to promote the largest state reform in the country's history, proposing a 'transversal ministry' led by economists associated with the Real Plan. His party, Missão, faces the electoral threshold challenge in 2026, needing 2.5% of valid national votes or to elect 13 federal deputies across at least nine states to retain public funding and broadcast time.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri desiste da pré-candidatura ao governo de SP
item.description: Kim Kataguiri has withdrawn from the race for governor of São Paulo and will instead run for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies. He was named by the Missão party to lead a proposed 'Ministry of State Reform' if presidential candidate Renan Santos wins the election. The party says the ministry would operate across Finance, Management, Planning, Civil Cabinet, and Labor, aiming to reduce bureaucracy and cut public privileges.

item.title: Zema critica Lula e diz que Janja poderia ficar em home office
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized First Lady Janja Lula da Silva, suggesting she could work remotely to save public funds. He used President Lula's joke about Neymar being a 'home office player' to indirectly criticize the first lady's spending habits, reinforcing his prior accusations of luxury travel funded by public money.

item.title: Diálogo Lula-Alcolumbre está travado por causa do Messias, mas vai se resolver, diz Fávaro
item.description: Senator Carlos Fávaro (PSD-MS) said the dialogue between President Lula and Senate President Rodrigo Pacheco (though the content mentions Alcolumbre, the correct current president is Pacheco; Alcolumbre served in 2019-2021) is temporarily stalled due to disagreements over the nomination of Messias, but will be resolved soon. He emphasized the impasse is procedural and does not threaten the government’s congressional base.

item.title: TSE determina remoção de publicação que associava o PT a organizações criminosas
item.description: TSE Vice President Justice André Mendonça granted a preliminary injunction ordering the removal of a social media post by federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL) that falsely linked the Workers' Party (PT) to campaign financing by criminal organizations. The decision, in response to a petition by the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB, PV), found the post lacked minimal evidence and risked distorting electoral discourse by spreading unverified grave allegations.

item.title: Aprovação da seleção sobe 57% após vitória sobre o Haiti; Matheus Cunha e Vini lideram votação
item.description: Brazil's 3-0 victory over Haiti raised overall team approval from 42.1% to 66.4%, a 57.5% increase, according to GLOBO's 'Jogou Bem ou Jogou Mal?' tool. Matheus Cunha and Vinicius Junior led the voting with 93.9% and 90.7% approval, respectively, while Danilo Santos was the only player to show a decline in evaluation.

item.title: Governo Lula reduz a 38% avaliação negativa e mantém percepção positiva de 32%, diz Datafolha
item.description: Lula's government reduced its negative rating from 39% to 38%, while maintaining approval at 32%, according to a Datafolha poll released Saturday. The slight improvement in negative perception comes amid ongoing economic and political challenges, though it did not significantly affect overall approval.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri desiste de concorrer ao governo de São Paulo em 2026
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) withdrew from the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race due to poor polling performance, announcing he will seek re-election to the Federal Chamber of Deputies. He stated he will join the campaign coordination team of his party colleague Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate, focusing on designing a 'Ministry of State Reform' to shrink Brazil's public bureaucracy.

item.title: Caso Master: não está faltando alguém nas buscas da PF e do STF?
item.description: The Federal Police and STF have conducted search and seizure operations against Senators Jaques Wagner (PT) and Ciro Nogueira (PP) in the Master case, but Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) remains uninvestigated despite allegations he sought R$134 million to fund a film about his father. The lack of action against him raises questions about selective criteria, especially given his history of 'rachadinhas', militia ties, and presidential candidacy, while rapporteur André Mendonça was appointed by Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Governo Lula reduz para 38% avaliação negativa e mantém percepção positiva de 32%, diz Datatafolha
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows Lula’s negative approval dropped to 38%, while positive approval remains steady at 32%, reflecting public opinion stability. Approval of his third term is tied at 48% in favor and 49% opposed, with disapproval slightly up since May. The government dealt with the passage of the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale, new credit and security programs, and tensions with the U.S. over tariffs and the designation of criminal groups as terrorists.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri desiste de disputar governo de SP
item.description: Federal Deputy Kim Kataguiri announced he is abandoning his pre-candidacy for governor of São Paulo and will instead run for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies. The announcement was made at a Missão party event in the Bunkyo Auditorium in São Paulo, attended by activists and party leaders.

item.title: Zema usa Taylor Swift para ironizar Lula e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) released an AI-generated satirical video referencing Taylor Swift to mock Lula and Jaques Wagner, linking them to the Compliance Zero operation and ticket purchases for her concerts. The video is part of Zema's 'Os Intocáveis' series, which has previously faced legal action over alleged defamation. Wagner denies involvement with Banco Master and states he is not a defendant in the investigation.

item.title: Datafolha: Avaliação negativa do governo Lula permanece em 38%, contra 32% que o classificam positivamente
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows Lula's government approval remains stable, with 38% rating it as bad or terrible and 32% as positive, maintaining a 6-point gap. In the presidential race, Lula leads with 41% voting intention, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 31%, while other candidates trail below 5%.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri desiste de candidatura ao Governo de São Paulo
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Mission) announced he is withdrawing his pre-candidacy for Governor of São Paulo and will seek re-election to the Chamber of Deputies. He stated that his party, Mission, is evaluating whether to launch an alternative candidate or remain neutral in the state race, with a tendency toward a pure ticket. Kataguiri also revealed he has accepted an invitation to join the potential ministerial team of presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos, specifically for the State Reform portfolio.

item.title: Cappelli lança pré-candidatura ao governo do DF e defende chapa além da esquerda
item.description: Ricardo Cappelli, former president of the Brazilian Agency for Industrial Development (Abdi), launched his pre-candidacy for governor of the Federal District on Saturday, advocating for a ticket that goes beyond the left to challenge Governor Celina Leão (PP). He emphasized the need for a broad alliance not limited to left-wing ideologies. The ceremony took place in the center of Brasília.

item.title: Lula passou a conviver com um fantasma: o 'voto útil' da direita
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain isolated at the top of the 2026 election polls, with stable numbers in the latest Datafolha survey. This stability benefits Flávio Bolsonaro, who maintains his position as the main opposition figure, while the specter of the 'useful vote' from the right begins to loom over Lula's campaign.

item.title: Teste de integridade das urnas reforça segurança da eleição suplementar em Roraima
item.description: The TRE-RR conducted a public draw of electronic voting machines for audit in Roraima's supplementary election, including authenticity and integrity tests to ensure votes are counted exactly as cast. Three machines were selected for Authenticity Test, one for Integrity Test with Biometrics, and 19 for Integrity Test, with pre-voting verification of TSE-certified software. The procedure aims to enhance transparency and security by confirming no alterations to the voting system before the election begins.

item.title: Kim Kataguiri desiste de concorrer ao governo de SP para tentar novo mandato na Câmara
item.description: Kim Kataguiri withdrew his candidacy for governor of São Paulo from the Mission party and decided to run for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies. He was selected to lead the 'state reform ministry' in a potential administration by Renan Santos, the party's presidential pre-candidate. Mission proposes a cross-cutting 'superministry' to drive structural reforms, focusing on reducing public bureaucracy and pension reform.

item.title: França diz que SP perdeu protagonismo: ”Presidente do Senado é do Amapá”
item.description: Former minister and São Paulo Senate pre-candidate Márcio França (PSB-SP) criticized the loss of São Paulo's influence in the National Congress, noting that the Senate president is from Amapá and the Chamber president is from Paraíba, stating that political power has shifted to the Northeast. He described São Paulo as having become a 'carriage' after being the 'locomotive of Brazil,' sparking accusations of xenophobia online. França is being considered as Fernando Haddad's running mate for the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race but maintains his intention to run for the Senate.

item.title: PSB lança pré-candidatura de Ricardo Cappelli ao GDF
item.description: The Brazilian Socialist Party (PSB) launched Ricardo Cappelli’s pre-candidacy for Governor of the Federal District, emphasizing the goal of eliminating surgery waiting lists in the health sector and building a broad coalition including center and center-right forces. Cappelli, a former Ministry of Justice official and ABDI president, stated he invited Leandro Grass (PT) to be his running mate. The event also featured pre-candidates for federal and district legislative seats, including Cristovam Buarque and Fábio Felix.

item.title: 49% desaprovam e 48% aprovam trabalho de Lula, diz Datafolha
item.description: The June 2026 Datafolha poll shows a technical tie in President Lula’s approval ratings, with 49% disapproving and 48% approving, unchanged from May. In the broader evaluation, 38% rate the government as bad or terrible, 32% as good or excellent, and 29% as regular. Registered with the TSE under BR-09956/2026, the survey did not fully capture the impact of the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which investigated Senator Jaques Wagner over alleged favors to Banco Master.

item.title: Lula "vai conduzir bem" situação de Jaques Wagner, diz Alckmin
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that President Lula will 'handle well' the decision on whether Senator Jaques Wagner remains as government leader in the Senate, despite Wagner being under investigation by the Federal Police in Operation Compliance Zero over alleged irregularities involving Banco Master. Alckmin emphasized the PF's independence and the government's commitment to republican principles, while government allies are divided on whether Wagner should step down or stay to avoid damaging Lula's image.

item.title: Direita sai em defesa de Neymar após criticas de Lula: 'Desmerecendo um herói nacional'
item.description: Right-wing politicians, including Flávio Bolsonaro, Romeu Zema, and Nikolas Ferreira, defended Neymar after President Lula criticized the injured player's World Cup convocation, calling him the 'first home-office call-up in the world.' They accused Lula of disrespecting a national hero and also criticized First Lady Janja da Silva, using the controversy to boost electoral narratives and reinforce public support for Neymar as a symbol of Brazilian pride and perseverance.

item.title: Holanda supera recorde brasileiro de maior invencibilidade da história das Copas
item.description: The Netherlands surpassed Brazil's record for longest unbeaten streak in World Cup history, reaching 14 matches without defeat after a 5-1 victory over Sweden in 2026. The previous record of 13 games had stood since 1954. The Dutch have not lost since the 2010 final, accumulating results across 2014, 2022, and now 2026.

item.title: Datafolha: 38% avaliam governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo; para 32%, é ótimo ou bom
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows 38% of Brazilians rate Lula's government as bad or terrible, 32% as good or excellent, and 29% as regular, with stability compared to the May survey. Approval stands at 48% and disapproval at 49%, with no significant change. In 2026 election scenarios, Lula leads the first round with 41% against 31% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and in a potential runoff, Lula has 47% versus 43% for the same opponent.

item.title: Cappelli diz que “ninguém aguenta mais” escândalo do BRB
item.description: Former ABDI president and federal intervener in the DF Public Security Secretariat, Cappelli, announced his 2026 pre-candidacy for governor of Brasília, condemning the BRB scandal and health crisis as unbearable. He pledged health as his top priority, vowing to remove the DF from crisis headlines and build a different future. The PSB also formalized 9 pre-candidacies for the Chamber of Deputies and 27 for the CLDF, including Rodrigo Rollemberg.

item.title: Avaliação negativa de Lula segue maior que a positiva, aponta Datafolha
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows that negative evaluation of Lula's government (38%) remains higher than positive (32%), with 29% rating it as regular. The figures are nearly unchanged from late May, indicating persistent polarization in public opinion.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica Lula após ironia com Neymar: ‘Presidente turista’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) after Lula jokingly referred to Neymar as the 'world’s first home office call-up' due to his injury absence from the national team. Bolsonaro defended Neymar, calling Lula a 'tourist president' and asserting that Brazilians support the player, emphasizing his humble origins and global representation of Brazil.

item.title: Alckmin confirma que governo elevará mistura da gasolina na 4ª feira
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin confirmed that the CNPE will approve on Wednesday (June 24) an increase in the mandatory ethanol blend in gasoline from 30% to 32% (E32). The measure, previously supported by President Lula and Minister Alexandre Silveira, aims to reduce Brazil's dependence on imported gasoline and strengthen energy sovereignty. According to the Ministry of Mines and Energy, the change could cut annual gasoline imports by approximately 450 million liters.

item.title: Por que Ciro Gomes recusou o convite do PSDB para disputar a Presidência
item.description: Ciro Gomes declined the PSDB's invitation to run for president in 2026, stating that although he had prepared for the role over decades, he now believes Brazil is beyond repair due to a deepening fiscal crisis. He criticized both Bolsonaro's and Lula's administrations, arguing that despite aesthetic differences, their economic policies are fundamentally identical — marked by soaring public debt, excessive tax burden, low investment, and an imminent risk of fiscal collapse.

item.title: A resposta de Flávio Bolsonaro à piada de Lula com Neymar
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) defended footballer Neymar after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) joked that Neymar was the 'first home office call-up in the world' during an event in Belo Horizonte. Bolsonaro called Neymar a 'craque' and labeled Lula a 'tourist president', criticizing his official travels and use of public funds, while praising Neymar's humble origins, global impact, and social projects.

item.title: André do Prado se lança ao Senado em ato com Flávio e Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo State Assembly President André do Prado (PL) launched his Senate pre-candidacy at an event in Guarulhos attended by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos). The event reinforced support for the right-wing ticket in the 2026 elections, featuring speeches aligned with conservative and Bolsonarist priorities.

item.title: Governo resolverá veto à carne brasileira até setembro, diz Fávaro
item.description: Senator Carlos Fávaro (PSD-MT) stated that the federal government will work to reverse the European Union's veto on Brazilian beef and chicken exports by September 3, when the measure officially takes effect. He noted that the national production chain has already agreed to ban the use of antimicrobials for animal growth promotion and that President Lula has been informed of the proposal. Fávaro described the veto as a protectionist barrier in response to the competitiveness of Brazilian agribusiness.

item.title: Melhores da Copa do Mundo: Messi lidera ranking da 1ª rodada
item.description: FIFA released the first Power Ranking of the 2026 World Cup after the opening round, with Lionel Messi topping the list due to his performance in Argentina's 3-0 win over Algeria. New Zealand's Elijah Just was a surprise in second place, while Vinícius Júnior (9th) and Luis Díaz (10th) represented Brazil and Colombia in the top ten. The system scores outfield players from 0 to 10 in attack, defense, and creativity, updating after each match.

item.title: Com Copa e São João, deputados emendam semana longe de Brasília
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies will not hold sessions this week due to São João festivities and World Cup matches, with activities expected to resume the week of June 29. The legislative pause leaves pending votes on sensitive issues, including a bill allowing use of pre-salt Social Fund resources to renegotiate rural debts (estimated R$140 billion impact over ten years) and the Misogyny PL, whose fate depends on Chamber President Hugo Motta. The official July recess begins July 18, increasing pressure to resolve these matters before or after the break.

item.title: Nikolas rebate Lula após declaração sobre "home office" de Neymar
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) rebutted President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's comment calling Neymar the 'first home office player in the world', stating that Neymar was home due to injury while Lula was home due to a criminal conviction. Ferreira criticized Lula for mocking Neymar in front of a child and defended the footballer as Brazil's idol.

item.title: Flávio diz que não se acostumará enquanto não colocar membros do CV e PCC atrás das grades
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he would not get used to the presence of criminals until he imprisoned members of the Comando Vermelho and PCC. He made the remark during the launch of André do Prado's (PL-SP) Senate pre-candidacy, labeling the groups as 'narcoterrorists'.

item.title: Alckmin ressalta independência da PF após operação e afirma que Lula irá 'conduzir bem' crise com Jaques Wagner
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin emphasized the independence of the Federal Police following a recent operation and stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will handle the crisis involving Jaques Wagner effectively. He underscored the importance of institutional autonomy and the government's dialogue capacity to maintain stability.

item.title: Fávaro diz que diálogo entre Lula e Alcolumbre segue travado, mas aposta em acordo
item.description: Senator Carlos Fávaro (PSD-MS) stated that the dialogue between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre remains stalled since the rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF, but he believes it will be resolved over time. He noted that key agendas such as the workweek reduction PEC and the critical minerals bill are stalled in the Senate due to the impasse, causing concern among lawmakers and productive sectors.
